title: Traveller Seat Rate Card for Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
A seat on a corporate programme is a place contracted for a named traveller. The Corporate Travel Programmes price seats in four ways at once — a floor and a ceiling on how many seats a tier accepts, a quantity of seats the subscription already carries, a monthly licence rate for each seat beyond those, and a charge for moving a seat from one traveller to another after it has been held for a period. This rate card publishes all four for every tier.

The columns carry their charter meanings: the smallest number of traveller seats the programme may be contracted for; the traveller seats carried by the subscription before seat licences are charged; the largest number of traveller seats the programme tier accepts; the monthly licence charge for each seat beyond those included, in USD; the charge to move a seat from one named traveller to another, in USD; and the calendar days a seat must be held by a traveller before it may be reassigned.

| Programme tier | Minimum seats | Seats included | Maximum seats | Seat licence rate, per seat per month (USD) | Reassignment charge (USD) | Reassignment cool-off (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 1 | 3 | 9 | 9.00 | 25.00 | 90 |
| Business Team Programme | 5 | 10 | 49 | 7.50 | 15.00 | 60 |
| Business Pro Programme | 20 | 35 | 199 | 6.00 | 10.00 | 30 |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 75 | 120 | 749 | 4.50 | 0.00 | 14 |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 250 | 400 | 2499 | 3.25 | 0.00 | 7 |
| Business Global Programme | 750 | 1200 | 25000 | 2.00 | 0.00 | 0 |

## Reading the ranges

Each tier's seat range is inclusive of both figures printed for it. Taking three hypothetical seat counts against this card:

- 9 traveller seats sits exactly on the Business Starter Programme's maximum of 9 and so inside that tier's range of 1 to 9; the same count also sits inside the Business Team Programme's range of 5 to 49.
- 60 traveller seats sits above the Business Team Programme's maximum of 49 and inside the Business Pro Programme's range of 20 to 199.
- 800 traveller seats sits above the Business Enterprise Programme's maximum of 749 and inside both the Business Enterprise Plus Programme's range of 250 to 2499 and the Business Global Programme's range of 750 to 25000.

The seat licence rate falls as the tier rises, while the quantity of seats included rises; the reassignment charge falls to nil from the Business Enterprise Programme upward, and the cool-off period falls from 90 calendar days to nil across the same span.
